text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training is progressing smoothly toward 
our set target, the Hanshin Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Haa, —haa.
choice_data_list:
Good work on the slope! Let's take a 
little break.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Mmh... mmh...
choice_data_list:
Race day is almost here—how are you 
feeling?

Race day's almost here—how are you 
feeling?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ! Ah... U-Um.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... n-not ba... Never mind.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I-I th... think it's great...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. Um, er, ...yes...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I-It didn't end very smoothly... but! 
...I said it...!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Because it's true. I really... feel like 
I can do it.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
('High stamina' and 'legs that can sustain 
a long run'... ...Trainer told me that a 
long time ago.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Instead of thinking "there's no way," I 
told myself "what if it's possible?" 
Believe, just believe... and if I just 
keep running...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I don't lose my breath as easily as 
before. At the very end, for one more 
step, one more meter, I've learned to hang 
on...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I... even I can do this properly—!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I... I think I've gotten stronger. 
Properly.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"So, um... Until the real thing, even 
more!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Please train me even harder...! I'm 
counting on you, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's keep getting stronger and 
stronger!

Yeah, let's keep getting stronger and 
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Little by little, step by step, Cheval 
Grand was changing. And so, the days of 
training alongside her went on—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And now, finally...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the Hanshin Daishoten is finally 
about to begin. First, let us turn our 
eyes to the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: *deep breath*... *pheeew*.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—And now, making her appearance in the 
paddock next is Cheval Grand.”

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she has a calm expression on her 
face. We can expect a fine run from her.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, today is...! Um, n-nice to—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan Angler
text_block_list.text: Cheval Graaand!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan Angler
text_block_list.text:
Heeeeeeey, hehehe!! I came to watch 
youuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... c-could it be... Did we meet at the 
wharf last year...?)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan Angler
text_block_list.text:
Reel in that victory like a big catch 
too!! I'm rootin' for yaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, nice one, mister! ...Well, count me 
in too!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I'm cheering for you, Cheval-kunnn!! Can't 
wait to see you look super cool out there!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, exactly!! We're counting on you, 
Cheval Grand!!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... wha, ah, waah...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-What incredible cheering!? I've... 
n-never seen anything like this—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Maybe... it wasn't the first time.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(The truth is, even in my past races... 
maybe there were people cheering for me 
after all.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(It was just that... I hadn't been 
looking. ...Just like with myself.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Phew... Whew...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, the cheers! Thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Today... I-I came here to win. I... look 
forward to running with you!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH----!! Way to go, Cheval 
Graaaand!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Waha~☆ Whaaaat a massive cheer!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Sis! Cheval-chi is so cool, 
right? ♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes... That's true.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It was like that before too. ...Now, even 
more so."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Let us watch closely, Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: She's going to be strong today—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"...That was incredible earlier, 
Cheval-chan."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ! ...Shine.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"Become a great Umamusume," huh... If it's 
Cheval-chan, I'm sure she'll just keep 
getting stronger and make it come true.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I have a dream I want to grasp, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
To achieve results to be proud of, to 
seize the crown. To stand at the center of 
cheers that reach the heavens.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I've run all this time for that very 
purpose. I've trained for it.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"That's why. ...Even against you, I won't 
lose."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Same here. I won't back down, not 
even to you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Let's race, Shine...!!
